integrity: The general formulas are proved algebraically. Finite-field enumerations in the verifier are regression witnesses, not substitutes for the all-prime-power proof.
scientific_limitations: Counts tangencies at smooth F_q-points only; it does not classify additional non-rational tangencies or the full geometric dual curve. Originality remains subject to unindexed literature under different finite-geometry terminology.
title: Exact rational Gauss-fiber census for the Asgarli–Ghioca tangent-filling curve
